newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bank of Israel alters contsruction-lending rules.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Israel alters contsruction-lending rules.

text.p: The Bank of Israel said on Sunday that it was altering some of the criteria it uses for measuring the banking sector's exposure to property-development debt.

Under the new regulations, the bank toughened criteria by including for the first time mortgage bank lending to developers in its calcuation of total property-development lending by the banking sector. It also said it would begin including lending for income-producing properties in its definition of overall property lending.
Against that, the central bank said it would remove some minor forms of lending from the property-lending category.

The Bank of Israel has been restricting lending to property development out of concern that the banks' lending portfolios have become overexposed to a single industry. But property developers have accused the central bank of creating a credit crunch that has helped precipitate a building slowdown.
